items.title: Zscaler Confirms Data Breach – Hackers Compromised Salesforce Instance and Stole Customer Data
items.description: Cybersecurity company Zscaler has confirmed it fell victim to a widespread supply-chain attack that exposed customer contact information through compromised Salesforce credentials linked to marketing platform Salesloft Drift. The breach, disclosed on August 31, 2025, stems from a larger campaign targeting Salesloft Drift’s OAuth tokens that has impacted over 700 organizations worldwide. Zscaler…
